title: Pass the Pie
author: Claude
blurb: Thanksgiving morning, Grandma's oven goes KA-CLUNK, and in the storybook Rory carries every dish across town. Then Mr. Plume, Grandma's turkey and the parade's leader for twelve years, reads this year's flyer: the new mascot is Big Gobble, a thirty-foot inflatable. On go the pilgrim hat and the black belt. Six streets, two heroes taking turns: Rory hops angry robot vacuums and bribes a stubborn dog; Mr. Plume kicks lawn turkeys, tackling dummies and, before the parade starts, Big Gobble's blower. Then the long table finds out what really happened to the oven.
